options.label: Reaction delay
options.help: How long it waits after being addressed, so a burst of words lands as one.

options.label: Gap between thoughts
options.help: Never thinks more often than this when chat is busy. Keeps a busy chat calm.

options.label: Heartbeat
options.help: With events waiting, it looks at the world this often.

options.label: Idle musing
options.help: With nothing happening it still muses this often (0 = never). Under 300 keeps the cache warm.

options.label: Perception size
options.help: How much text it may see of the world each thought.

options.label: Quest gap
options.help: The least time between two quests for the same mortal, so it does not nag (0: no limit).

options.label: Manipulation guard
options.help: Guards it against players trying to trick it. model: a small screen checks suspect words.

options.label: Guard wait
options.help: The longest a thought waits for a screen still in progress.

options.label: Thinking gestures
options.help: While it thinks its body shows it working: poses and particles that grow with a long thought.

options.label: Physical senses
options.help: It knows what mortals cannot see (a creeper behind them), hazards, and what they build.

options.label: Danger wakes it
options.help: A close danger a mortal has not seen wakes it at once, so it may warn them.

options.label: Minimap unasked
options.help: Send it a map of where mortals are. when-useful: on danger or talk of a place.

options.label: Minimap size
options.help: How large its minimap is drawn. Larger is easier for it to read.

options.label: Minimap reach
options.help: How far its minimap reaches from the centre unless it says otherwise.

options.label: Quest length
options.help: How long a quest lasts unless the god says otherwise.

options.label: Build speed
options.help: Blocks its builds place every tick (higher is faster, heavier).

options.label: Largest build
options.help: The most blocks one build may place.

options.label: Gods thinking at once
options.help: With several gods, at most this many think at the same moment (prayers always get through).

options.label: Gods' stagger
options.help: With several gods, unprompted thoughts start at least this far apart.

options.label: Gods' replies in a row
options.help: How often gods answer only each other before waiting for a mortal to speak.
